posts.cooked:
I just noticed that throughout her deck her energy spikes are always blue exept for her incap side. The color yellow they then take mirroring Dawn's typical power color is probably not haphazard especially considering Dawn is on the incap.

Could this indicate that Dawn can affect other mutants (of course return with the dawn already shows effect on others)?

Could this incap be a mirror to when Magneto stripped the Adamantium out of Wolverine? (it ain't litteraly the same but both times seem like a use of power to get substance or energy out of a body agains't their will) The absolute lack of damage to Knyfe's armor would support a loss of control induced by Dawn.

I'd like to know your take on all this as you are usually better than me at fishing out conspiracy theories.

K.N.Y.F.E.'s powers come from her tech, not mutant powers. Not sure that F.I.L.T.E.R. would employ someone not 'pure' human.

However, spending over a decade around the The Block’s occupants and its temporal containment systems irrevocably altered her physiology, which took more of a toll on Huntly than it did most.   She spent weeks in the neo-superhuman development wing of the infirmary as energy spikes erupted all over her body.

Under3:

I took it as those spikes of energy come from an attack from Dawn and aren't K.N.Y.F.E.'s.

One of them has the same shape and placement as on the card For the Greater Good and we've seen dawn attack with energy blasts but not spikes that remain as far as I know. Most of the spikes have one end hidden but the few we see completely are sharp on both edges which is more consistent with an internal origin than having the control to precisely get them all planted halfway. Of course it all brings the question on how energy spikes deal with her suit. Her incap also seems reminescent from her origin and I quote from her bio: ''She spent weeks in the neo-superhuman development wing of the infirmary as energy spikes erupted all over her body.''

In fact it just struck me how strange it is for a dimensional prison to even have a neo-superhuman development wing…
